name: Seattle
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Seattle Department of Construction and Inspections (SDCI)
notes: 2026 Fee Subtitle (SMC Ch. 22.900) effective Jan 1, 2026. Construction permit fees rose 18% YoY; most other fees +6.5%. Base/hourly rate $292. 5% technology fee (22.900A.100). WA State Building Code Council $6.50 on each residential building permit (RCW 19.27.085).

name: Charlotte
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Mecklenburg County Code Enforcement (LUESA) — issues City of Charlotte building/trade permits
notes: Charlotte building/trade permits are issued by Mecklenburg County Code Enforcement under the LUESA Fee Ordinance (revised July 1, 2026; N.C.G.S. 160D-1110). Separate BEMP permits. Like-for-like reroof ≤ $40,000 is permit-exempt under 160D-1110(c)(5). HVAC change-outs use Section II.D.1 TIP (1.5 × $59.70). Renovations under $100,000 use Note a ($79.61/trade plus per-sf of the room). New decks also need City of Charlotte LDIRL zoning/stormwater review (FY2027 city line items not extracted).

name: Austin
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Austin Development Services Department (DSD)
notes: FY 2025-26 fee schedule effective Oct 1, 2025. Residential fees are mostly square-footage / program-based (not a single valuation table). Line items used here come from City Council FY26 fee exhibit (File 25-1121 / CM Vela Attachment 1). Credit-card portal surcharge 2.35% ($2 min).

name: Denver
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Community Planning and Development (CPD)
notes: Valuation-based building/trade fees in ADMIN 138, republished on denvergov.org/DSfees. Plan review is 50% of the permit fee for work over $2,000. Roofing/siding and some mechanical work can qualify as Quick Permits (no plan review).

name: Phoenix
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Planning and Development Department (PDD)
notes: PDD Fee Schedule approved Dec 17, 2025, Ordinance G-7465, effective Jan 20, 2026 (Phoenix City Code Ch. 9 App. A.2). Single valuation-based building permit typically covers trades. Plan review: 100% of permit (min $195) for residential ≤$50k when valuation >$5,000.

name: Nashville
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025); Nashville-Davidson metropolitan government
permitDeptName: Department of Codes and Building Safety
notes: 1-2 family residential building permit is $5.00 per $1,000 of valuation (16.28.110 A.1), plus $25 zoning examination and 10% Codes Tech Fee on the valuation fee. Plan-review fee is exempt for one- and two-family dwellings. Separate plumbing (min $75) and gas/mechanical (min $75) permits.

name: Atlanta
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Department of City Planning, Office of Buildings
notes: ATL311 (updated May 20, 2026) states the minimum permit cost is $150 plus a $25 technology fee. Full valuation schedule is in the Code of Ordinances; a complete extractable fee table was not obtained, so amounts above the published minimum are left null. Deck/patio additions and interior alterations are listed as residential permit types.

name: Portland
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Portland Permitting & Development (PP&D)
notes: Building and Other Permits Fee Schedule effective July 10, 2026. Separate electrical, mechanical, and plumbing schedules. Oregon adds a 12% state surcharge on building-permit fees. Additional PP&D plan-review / development-services fees exist on the same PDF and are NOT fully extracted here — totals below are the building-permit line plus the 12% surcharge only.

name: Minneapolis
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Community Planning & Economic Development — Minneapolis Development Review
notes: Building permits use the city valuation table + 65% plan review + MN state surcharge of 0.0005 × value (Title 5 Ch. 91; official Smartsheet on the building-fees page, city page last updated Feb 27, 2026). Existing-dwelling HVAC uses the existing-residential mechanical levels ($84.20 / $132.40 / $216.60 + $1 surcharge). Plumbing minimum is $85.20 including $1 surcharge. Electrical is a separate Minnesota DLI permit.

name: Raleigh
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Planning and Development Department
notes: FY27 Development Fee Guide (July 1, 2026–June 30, 2027). New residential building permit is 0.38% of calculated construction value. Alterations: Level 1 = 28% of building permit; Level 2 = 50%; Level 3 = 75%. Minimum trade permit $124. Alteration plan review 55% of building permit (min $124). Credit-card processing 3.5% (min $2.50) as of July 1, 2026.

name: Chicago
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Chicago Department of Buildings (DOB)
notes: 2026 Amended Building Permit Fee Tables effective Jan 6, 2026 (plan-based, min $602). Stand-alone fees are Municipal Code Table 14A-12-1204.2. Group R ≤4 stories: steep-slope (≥2:12) reroof and in-kind furnace/AC appliance replacement are permit-exempt. New decks typically plan-based ($602 min) because Express still excludes new structures.

name: Houston
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Houston Permitting Center (Building Code Enforcement)
notes: 2026 BCE Permit Fee Schedule (CPI +1.3910% Jan 1, 2026). Admin $33.56; most permits min $91.06. 1-2 family structural fees are Type/sf tables (repairs/alterations = 20% of new-construction fee) plus admin — not a single valuation table. HVAC repairs/alterations = 2% of valuation + $47, then min + admin. Roof covering ≤100 sf is exempt.

name: Los Angeles
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety (LADBS)
notes: City of Los Angeles (not LA County). Building permits use LAMC Table 1-A (Ord. 185,587; still the published table). Express permits: P/GI 2026-003. Plan check 90% of Table 1-A when plans are required. HVAC uses posted Fee Sch. 3 (7/2017). City DSCS 3% + Systems 6%; state SMIP 0.013% and CBSC $1/$25,000 on building permits. LAMC 91.107.1.1 CPI may be applied in the live calculator; published table dollars are used here.

name: Dallas
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Planning and Development — Building Inspection (Development Services)
notes: Permit Fee Schedule effective July 1, 2025. SF/duplex master alterations use Table B-II ($181/dwelling unit + $100 additional trade) plus $15 technology. Standalone trades use Table B-I (value × 0.009652 × 1.33, min $175) plus $125 inspection per trade + $15 tech. Reroof ≤2 squares is exempt. No Texas state building-permit surcharge.

name: Miami
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Miami Building Department
notes: City of Miami (folio prefix 01), not Miami-Dade RER. Exhibit C (Resolution R-26-0200, Apr 23, 2026): residential ≤3 units = 0.50% of construction cost, min $110, plus $40 application. Roofing is exempt from city solid-waste surcharge. City collects F.S. 553.721 (1%) and 468.631 (1.5%) and Miami-Dade §8-12(e) $0.60/$1,000. SAVE 50% city-fee cut for qualifying storm-proof work is not assumed.

name: Boston
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Inspectional Services Department (ISD)
notes: ISD Building Fees PDF dated May 15, 2023 (still posted 2026-09-01). Short-form $20 + $10 per $1,000 of estimated cost; long-form $50 + $10 per $1,000. Reroof covering-only is short-form. New decks are long-form. Gas/sheet-metal/electrical/plumbing are separate trade permits. No Massachusetts building-permit surcharge on the ISD sheet.

name: Philadelphia
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Department of Licenses and Inspections (L&I)
notes: PG_012_INF construction fees effective Jan 1, 2025 (still in force 2026-09-01). Oct 1, 2026 PDF is published but not yet effective. 1-2 family roof covering replacement $69; mechanical ductwork incl. appliances $189; new accessory/deck $75 first 500 sf. Every permit: city $3 + PA $4.50 = $7.50. Cabinets/countertops-only are building-permit exempt (non-historic).

name: San Diego
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Development Services Department (DSD)
notes: City of San Diego, not the county. IB 501 (structures, Aug 2026) and IB 103 (MEP, 2026). Like-for-like reroof with no structure/diaphragm change is permit-exempt (SDMC §129.0203(a)(16); IB 123). HVAC is Simple MEP per-appliance (Table 1B). Decks use IB 501 Table 501C plus General Plan Maintenance $737 when plan review is required. Kitchen/bath no-plan combo is IB 103 Table 3A $440.82.

name: Las Vegas
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Las Vegas Building and Safety
notes: City of Las Vegas Building and Safety, not unincorporated Clark County. Posted 2020 Building User Fees effective July 1, 2021 remain the published tables. Residential reroof Table 3-E #94 $68+$119 plus $55 issuance. HVAC exact change-out Table 3-D #15 $83+$100 plus $55. Deck Table 3-E #20 $176+$290 plus $55. Kitchen remodel is priced by affected square feet (Table 3-A), not valuation — dollars left null.

name: Washington
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Department of Buildings (DOB)
notes: One jurisdiction (District of Columbia). Alteration/repair: ($30 + 2% of construction value) × 1.10 Enhanced/tech fee (12-M DCMR). Like-kind roofing/coping is permit-exempt outside historic districts and floodplain (12-A105.2). HVAC ≤10 tons typically Instant Mechanical $46 × 1.10 = $50.60. Deck FAQ uses the alteration formula without the green fee.

name: San Antonio
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: San Antonio Development Services Department (DSD)
notes: City of San Antonio DSD FY2026 Development Fee Schedule (Rev. October 2025). Covering-only reroof $25; carports/decks $160; full remodel $210 plus trade basics. Like-for-like HVAC uses existing-residential mechanical basic $50 plus per-device lines. Portal BuildSA.

name: Fort Worth
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Fort Worth Development Services Department
notes: Fort Worth Building Administrative Code §7-1 (Ord. 27191-09-2024). §105.2(14) covering-only R-3 reroof is exempt. HVAC uses Table 1-H equipment lines plus Table 1-B. Decks use Table 1-C-3 R-3 parenthetical rates. Kitchen remodeled by Table 1A-1 trades.

name: Tampa
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Tampa Construction Services Division (Development & Growth Management)
notes: City of Tampa Construction Services. Trade Permit Fee Schedule updated 2/16/2023 (effective Oct 1, 2018) and Miscellaneous Projects schedule updated 5/31/2020. Table values exclude the Florida Building Permit Surcharge (2.5% of permit value or $4.00 minimum).

name: Orlando
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Orlando Permitting Services Division (Economic Development Department)
notes: Residential (1 or 2 units) Permitting Development Fees effective January 2026. Building permit $66.24 first $1,000 + $4.41 each additional $1,000 or fraction. Mechanical/electrical use $66.24 first $1,000 + $11.03 each additional $1,000 through $25,000.

name: Jacksonville
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Jacksonville Building Inspection Division (Public Works)
notes: Consolidated City of Jacksonville / Duval County. Permit dollars from www.coj.net/fees implementing Ordinance Code §320.409. Roofing $10 per 1,000 sf with $150 inspection minimum. Mechanical HVAC $11/ton (1–10 tons), furnace first 200 kBTU $22, mechanical minimum $60.

name: Columbus
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Columbus Department of Building and Zoning Services (BZS)
notes: Building and Zoning Services 2026 Combined Development Related Fee Schedule (Columbus City Code §§ 4103.14, 901.01). 1-2-3 family: roof/siding/windows/doors $140; alterations $385; deck $350; MEP $275; minor work $140.

name: Indianapolis
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025), Indianapolis city (balance)
permitDeptName: Indianapolis Department of Business and Neighborhood Services (DBNS)
notes: DBNS fees updated January 5, 2026 (craft/electrical/HVAC/plumbing rates unchanged in that round). Class 2 structure permits under Revised Code Chapter 536.

name: Sacramento
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Sacramento Community Development Department (Building Division)
notes: City of Sacramento CDD, not Sacramento County. CDD-0245 revised 07-12-2026. HVAC and re-roof specific-cost permits $175 plus 10% technology surcharge. Kitchen/deck use the residential valuation building-permit + plan-review table.

name: Kansas City
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Kansas City, Missouri City Planning and Development, Permits Division
notes: KCMO (Jackson County), not Kansas City, Kansas. One- and two-family detached dwelling building/MEP fees are in Building Code Article 1 Section 18: $52 at $0–$1,000; $58 at $1,001–$2,000; then $58 + $4.33 per additional $1,000 through $100,000.

name: Detroit
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Detroit Buildings, Safety Engineering and Environmental Department (BSEED)
notes: BSEED Fee Schedule effective January 1, 2024, modified July 18, 2025. Building/residential permits: $271.43 at $2,000 or less; $271.43 + $34.09 per $1,000 over $2,000 through $25,000. HVAC uses mechanical equipment lines.

name: San Jose
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: San Jose Planning, Building and Code Enforcement (PBCE)
notes: City of San Jose PBCE, not Santa Clara County. FY 2026-27 Building and Structure Permits Fee Schedule effective August 10, 2026 is posted at sanjoseca.gov/buildingfees. Host blocked PDF download on 2026-09-01 so residential reroof/HVAC/deck/kitchen line-item dollars were not extracted.

name: San Francisco
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection (DBI)
notes: City and County of San Francisco DBI. Table 1A-A / 1A-C / 1A-G effective July 12, 2026. Re-roofing of single-family homes and duplexes is Table 1A-G $320, not the valuation table.

name: El Paso
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of El Paso Planning and Inspections Department
notes: City of El Paso Planning and Inspections (not El Paso County). FY 2026 Schedule C. Roofing Permit $118. Mechanical has a $110 base plus equipment. Applicable technology fee is listed on every line; the percentage is not printed, so it is not added.

name: Oklahoma City
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Oklahoma City Development Services
notes: Oklahoma City Municipal Code Ch. 60. Alterations/repair $6.00 per $1,000, minimum $75 (60-12-7), effective July 1, 2026. 1-2 family buildings are exempt from 60-12-6 plan review. City prints a $0.50 OUBCC collection fee (60-12-1); the state 59 O.S. § 1000.25 dollar is not printed on the city schedule and is not added.

name: Baltimore
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Baltimore City Department of Housing and Community Development (DHCD) — Permits and Building Inspections
notes: Baltimore City DHCD, not Baltimore County. Building, Fire, and Related Codes §109.6 fee schedules plus 5% Building Code Permit Tax (§109.7). Application fee $25 without plans / $125 with plans for 1-2 family (§109.5.7).

name: Milwaukee
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Milwaukee Department of Neighborhood Services (DNS) Permit & Development Center
notes: City of Milwaukee DNS (MCO 200-33), not suburban Milwaukee County. 1-2 family alterations 1.6% of construction cost (min $150). HVAC equipment table. Training and technology surcharge 1.6% plus a processing fee.

name: Memphis
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Memphis and Shelby County Office of Construction Code Enforcement (CCE)
notes: Memphis city building permits are issued by the joint Memphis and Shelby County CCE (same office as unincorporated Shelby County). 1-2 family alteration/repair $5 per $1,000 (min $50 / max $325). Decks $50. Mechanical dollars are from the still-posted 2019 CCE mechanical table.

name: Louisville
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Louisville Metro Department of Codes and Regulations, Construction Review
notes: Louisville-Jefferson County Metro Government. Census population is Louisville/Jefferson County metro government (balance) SUMLEV 162 641,962, not the 795,222 consolidated-city total. Building minimum $75. 1-2 family $0.105/sf; partial alterations $50 + $2.50 per $1,000. HVAC 1-2 family $105 first system, $50 each additional.

name: Albuquerque
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Albuquerque Planning Department, Building Safety Division
notes: City of Albuquerque 2024 Uniform Administrative Code (still the posted Building Safety fee tables). Table 112-A 1-2 family regional modifier 0.50; Table 112-G residential re-roof $70; Table 112-C mechanical. Plan review 65% of Table 112-A when plans are required.

name: Tucson
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Tucson Planning and Development Services Department (PDSD)
notes: City of Tucson PDSD, not unincorporated Pima County. FY27 Planning and Permitting Fee Schedule effective July 1, 2026. Construction Valuation Table 4-02.4. Trade permits $150 first item + $50 each additional (HVAC change-out is a trade). Digital filing 1% of the total fee, minimum $18.54.
